about: Every regex the ReDoS guard has caught before, with the exact vulnerable pattern (as it stood in the pack) and the pattern that replaced it. For the guard ticket's mutation proof: swap each vulnerable pattern into a scratch copy of rules/biasclear-rules.json at its location and show the new guard fails. python_probe is a quick Python re timing (finditer over the whole input, 6 s cap) by the PM on 2026-10-07; it is a hint, not the acceptance test. The CREDENTIAL_AS_PREMISE cases were found by the JavaScript guard's literal-based generator; these Python probes did not reproduce them, so use the guard's own generator on the vulnerable pack.
